deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v2.9.0 -> 5% ap-south, 5% eu-west (change window 01:00-02:00 UTC)
ravi: seeing spike in 4xx for ap-south, mostly 400 bad_request on a small sample
sre-oncall: can we set ap-south to 0% and pin back to v2.8.6 while we investigate?
lina:Agree. logs show new header `X-RW-Model` is sometimes empty leading to validation fail
ravi: reproducing locally with curl, header omitted -> 400. sending snippet
lina: recommend hold+pin. commands:
```
redwoodctl rollout update --region ap-south --traffic 0
redwoodctl rollout pin --region ap-south --version v2.8.6 --reason "header validation regression"
```
deploy-bot: running: `redwoodctl rollout update --region ap-south --traffic 0`
deploy-bot: ap-south traffic set to 0% (op: tx-21021)
deploy-bot: running: `redwoodctl rollout pin --region ap-south --version v2.8.6`
deploy-bot: pinned ap-south -> v2.8.6 (pin id: pin-2102) :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: plan: run ap-south smoke (request validation + small corpus). If green: keep pinned and ship patch; if failing: escalate to infra and widen pause
devex: drafting a short line for release notes/support: "AP-South canary paused due to header validation; fix in progress."
ravi: opening ticket INF-7203 with repro, assigning to header-owner
lina: stop/go: AP-South -> STOP. EU-West remains at 5% in OBSERVE. change window ~28m left
sre-oncall: note: pinned regions need manual resume/unpin. keep monitoring global errors
ravi: will update INF-7203 with follow-ups and patch ETA ~1.5 hours
deploy-bot: reminder: resume command `redwoodctl rollout resume --region ap-south` and unpin `redwoodctl rollout unpin --pin-id pin-2102`
lina: thanks team, posting this to the incident log and will follow up when patch PR is ready
